sanskrit: śunaṃ vatsān apā karomi śunaṃ badhnāmi tantyām | āgrayaṇaṃ brahmaṇāṃ havis tasmiñ jāgāra kaśyapaḥ ||
english: I drive away the calves for good fortune; I bind them to the tether-rope for good fortune. The first-offering, the oblation of the Brahmaṇas — over that Kaśyapa has kept vigil.

sanskrit: bāhuṃ vatsam upanayan pātre gāṃ duhann abravīt | ariṣṭaṃ brahmabhyo haviḥ śivaṃ kṛṇotu kaśyapaḥ ||
english: Leading the calf forward by the foreleg, milking the cow into the vessel, he spoke: "May Kaśyapa make the oblation free from harm, auspicious for the Brahmaṇas."

sanskrit: trayas tiṣṭhanti sukṛtasya loke trayo 'tīkāśās trīṇi śīrṣāṇy eṣām | trayas tiṣṭhanti parigṛhya kumbhīṃ yathā haviḥ kaśyapa na vyathātai ||
english: Three stand firm in the world of the well-performed rite; three shine forth beyond; these have three heads. Three stand firmly grasping the water-pot, so that the oblation, O Kaśyapa, may not go amiss.

sanskrit: satyāt sambhūto vadati taṇḍulān kṣīra āvapan | ṛṣir brahmabhya āgrayaṇaṃ ni vedayatu kaśyapaḥ ||
english: Born from truth, he speaks while scattering the rice-grains into the milk. May Kaśyapa the seer announce the first-offering to the Brahmaṇas.

sanskrit: ṛtumukhe candrabhāgaḥ pātra odanam ud dharāt | prāśnantu brahmāṇo havir yathā vedena kaśyapaḥ ||
english: At the opening of the season, Candrabhāga lifted the rice-dish out of the vessel. May the Brahmaṇas partake of the oblation, even as Kaśyapa does so in accordance with the Veda.

sanskrit: ye bhūtāny asṛjanta ye bhūtāny akalpayan | sarvasya vidvān adhvaryuḥ ṣaṇṇāṃ bhavatu kaśyapaḥ ||
english: Those who brought the beings into creation, those who arranged the beings in order — Kaśyapa, the adhvaryu who knows all things, may he be the master of the six.

sanskrit: śivā āpo vatsebhyaḥ śivā bhavantv oṣadhīḥ | vāto vatsebhyaḥ kaśyapaḥ śivaḥ śivaṃ tapatu sūryaḥ ||
english: Auspicious be the waters for the calves; auspicious may the herbs be. Auspicious be the wind for the calves, auspicious Kaśyapa; may the sun shine with beneficence.
